# The domain of a cluster spec path: the name of the directory of the path
# after a lexical clean (Go filepath.Clean). ONE table for both suites, so
# they cannot drift: internal/provision/provider_test.go
# (TestWriteProviderConfigDomainCases, Go WriteProviderConfig) and
# tests/unit/provider_test.bats ("provider::_spec_domain gives the domain of
# each row of the shared case table", bash provider::_spec_domain). The
# expected values come from the bash function. The hetzner provider refuses
# ".", ".." and "/" as a domain.
#
# Columns, separated by one TAB: <spec path> <domain>
.	.
..	.
/	/
clusters/prod.example.test/	clusters
a/../b	.
clusters/prod.example.test/cluster.lok8s.yaml	prod.example.test
clusters/prod.example.test/./cluster.lok8s.yaml	prod.example.test
clusters/prod.example.test/child/../cluster.lok8s.yaml	prod.example.test
clusters/prod.example.test/cluster.lok8s.yaml/	prod.example.test
//clusters//prod.example.test//cluster.lok8s.yaml	prod.example.test
cluster.lok8s.yaml	.
../cluster.lok8s.yaml	..
/../cluster.lok8s.yaml	/
/cluster.lok8s.yaml	/
a/b/../../..	.
../../x/cluster.lok8s.yaml	x
